name: kling-ai-openclaw
description: 可灵（Kling AI）for OpenClaw：AI image and video generation 插件，支持 text-to-image、image-to-image、text-to-video、image-to-video、参考图、单镜头和多分镜创作；适合海报、商品图、电商素材、广告短片与社交媒体视频。

scripts.check: node --check dist/cli-login.mjs && node --check dist/index.mjs && node --check dist/kling-mcp-config.mjs && node --check dist/kling-oauth-client.mjs && node --check dist/oauth-login.mjs && node --check dist/result-media.mjs
scripts.test: node --test tests/index.test.mjs tests/metadata.test.mjs tests/kling-oauth-client.test.mjs tests/oauth-login.test.mjs tests/result-media.test.mjs
